newsitem.title: USA: One Valley OKs stock split and cash div.
newsitem.headline: One Valley OKs stock split and cash div.

text.p: One Valley Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it has approved a five-for-four stock split in the form of a 25 percent stock dividend, along with an 11 percent increase in the quarterly cash dividend.
The stock split will give shareholders one additional share of One Valley common stock for each four shares of stock they hold, the company said.
The 25 percent stock dividend will be paid on October 9 to shareholders of record on September 30.
A $0.24 quarterly cash dividend is to be paid on all shares outstanding, including the additional shares from the stock split. It is to be paid October 15 to shareholders of record on September 30.
The company had paid $0.27 per share presplit.
